response.justification: Highly experienced fullstack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant TypeScript/Node.js production work, React and MongoDB experience at Optilyz, cloud (AWS CDK) and Kubernetes/Docker exposure, plus current hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling work that maps precisely to a hard-to-find requirement. Deep testing culture (TDD, built his own test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/testing courses) and strong polyglot breadth fit the 'multiple languages' and quality expectations. Main gaps are the absence of Nest.js and Vitest specifically, relatively light React/modern frontend depth compared to his Ember/backend focus, and only older Java experience with no Kotlin — all likely bridgeable given his demonstrated adaptability.
strengths: 15+ years fullstack with TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB and AWS in production
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience, matching a rare requirement
Exceptional testing/quality background: TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, teaches workshops
concerns: No stated Nest.js or Vitest experience from the primary stack
Frontend depth skews Ember/legacy; React exposure appears secondary
Kotlin absent and Java experience dates back to 2018; no PostgreSQL specifics

key_factors.factor: Gaps in specific stack (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
